title: Eligibility Unit Service Standard for Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
Halverson Clinical Laboratories verifies every coverage held under **Insurance Coverage & Claims** electronically. The standard periods for each payer class are set out below.

| Payer class | Re-verify when last verified more than this many calendar days before a date of service | Verification completed within (business days after details are received) | Longest stay pending verification before the coverage is set inactive (business days) | Corrected details resubmitted on the same coverage record within (calendar days after it became inactive) | Retroactive coverage before the effective date once enrollment is approved (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 90 | 1 | 3 | 60 | 0 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan | 30 | 1 | 3 | 60 | 0 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan | 90 | 1 | 3 | 60 | 0 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan | 30 | 1 | 3 | 60 | 90 |
| TRICARE Prime and Select | 60 | 2 | 5 | 60 | 0 |
| Commercial In-Network Plan | 30 | 1 | 3 | 60 | 0 |
| Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | 30 | 2 | 5 | 60 | 0 |

## Notes

- **Resubmission period.** Within the period shown, corrected member details may be resubmitted on the same coverage record; later, a new coverage record is added instead. The period is 60 calendar days for every payer class.
- **Retroactive coverage.** A figure of 0 means the payer class gives no retroactive coverage. Medicaid Managed Care Plan is the only payer class that covers retroactively, for 90 calendar days before the coverage effective date once enrollment is approved.
- **Re-verification.** The figure is a span measured back from the date of service to the date the coverage was last verified.

## Hypothetical illustration

A TRICARE Prime and Select coverage last verified 61 calendar days before a date of service exceeds the 60-day span and is re-verified; one last verified exactly 60 calendar days before it does not exceed the span. For a Medicare Advantage Plan coverage the same test turns on 30 calendar days.
